title: MACA loop-unroll refusal combines an implementable fixed grouping with an unqualified pipeline combination
observation: The three retained candidates are valid Cake IR but request partial unroll together with two or four stages; they remain unsupported by this successor. Fresh valid single-stage squared-distance Programs at R128/K256/N32 and R1024/K1024/N64 expose the separate fixed-partial-group gap: factors2/4 that divide the trip count are refused at c72acbd5 despite needing only the existing MACA tl.range and tl.static_range operations. This is a curated exact-source distinction, not a Finding inferred from rejection counts. The captured Triton3.6 range signature accepts loop_unroll_factor, but API keyword availability alone does not qualify the pipelined route.
proposed_change: Implement explicit single-stage fixed partial grouping with an outer range stepping tile*factor and an inner static range, preserving each original iterator value, tail mask, state initialization and once-per-owning-loop finalization. Require the factor to divide the fixed trip count exactly. Preserve full unroll and non-MCFATBIN routes. Keep dynamic/nondividing/pipelined combinations refused, naming the actual factor, stage and trip commitments and requiring an explicit author choice.

software_verification.Corpus_Gate: 180 unchanged cases at 83afd36a; successor device preparation at c0b09a37 passed the unchanged Corpus again
software_verification.scope: CPU loop-control traces and actual emitted nested loads/reductions/stores, tail masks, single stores, namespace collision and intended-owner refusals; actual isolated MACA3.6 offline compilation of four sealed independent candidates. Device qualification remains pending.

promotion_disposition: No device-capability or performance promotion yet. Frozen Study outcomes and all strict measurement gates remain unchanged. Pipelined partial unroll remains deferred.
